item.title: Standing in the Gap: Bringing Hope to Oklahoma City
item.description: Discover how Navigator Jared is living out the gospel in an OKC neighborhood, investing long-term in youth, families, and community transformation.

item.title: A Command Worth Following: Disciplemaking at Whidbey Island
item.description: Navigator Clay Miller’s military background helped him see Jesus’ commands in a new light, inspiring him to dedicate his life to multiplying spiritual generations.

item.title: How the Resurrection Restores Us: Interview with Derek Vreeland
item.description: Derek Vreeland, author of the Bible study Resurrection: 8 Lessons on How God Restores Us, shares his heart behind the study and how discipleship has impacted his life.

item.title: Unified in Diversity: How God Has Moved in Hispanic Communities Over 30 Years
item.description: Hispanic disciplemakers serve faithfully in their communities, fostering a sense of “familia” that embraces the beauty of Latino culture and the unity of the body of Christ.

item.title: Why Am I Alive? How One Man’s Question Led to a Lifetime of Discipleship
item.description: From college Bible studies to church planting in Venezuela, Marc Wallace’s story shows how discipleship rooted in Scripture transforms lives.

item.title: 3 Motivations Needed to Create a Disciplemaking Culture
item.description: What motivates believers to grow a disciplemaking culture? Learn more about how to be like Jesus, help save those who don’t know Him, and participate in God’s covenantal promises.

item.title: Seen and Known: Discovering the Gospel in Every Culture
item.description: Mosaic helps students discover how the gospel meets their cultural identity, bringing healing, belonging, and a bigger vision of God’s Kingdom.

item.title: One Step at a Time: Bonding Families on the Trail
item.description: Eagle Lake Camps’ Mom Teen Trek and Dad Teen Trek programs create space for parents and children to seek God together.

item.title: A New Heart for the Gospel
item.description: A Navigator discipled Tom Hatch through seasons of tragedy, trial, and health challenges. Now, Tom is doing the same for his fellow first responders.

item.title: A Space of Belonging: The Navigators ASAM Network
item.description: Esther found discipleship through The Navigators — and through the ASAM Network, discovered belonging, mentorship, and a vision to multiply faith across cultures.

item.title: NavPress Celebrates the Release of ‘The Message Women’s Devotional Bible,’ Five Years in the Making
item.description: This fall, after a careful editorial and production process spanning nearly five years, NavPress (a business ministry of The Navigators) celebrated the release of The Message Women’s Devotional Bible.

item.title: Divine Appointments: How One Knock Impacted Generations
item.description: A desperate prayer. A knock at the door. See how one act of obedience in a college dorm led to generations transformed by the gospel.

item.title: What is the One Thing Necessary for Raising Disciples of Jesus?
item.description: Discover the key destination for raising disciples — and how a clear discipleship map can help children grow to become more like Christ every day.

item.title: Meeting the Nations in Michigan: Patrick’s Story
item.description: Decades of discipleship led Henry Bouma to Patrick Gakuru, a young Rwandan leader now sparking a new generation of disciplemakers in Grand Rapids.
